    private val textStyle1 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle2 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle3 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle4 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle5 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle6 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle7 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle8 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    private val textStyle9 = TextStyle(color = Color(0x80FF0000), fontSize = 12.5f.sp)

    @Composable
    override fun Composable(windowInsets: WindowInsets) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().windowInsetsPadding(windowInsets).padding(16.dp),
        ) {
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopStart),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle1,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle2,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle3,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterStart),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle4,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle5,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterEnd),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle6,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomStart),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle7,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle8,
            )
            BasicText(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd),
                text = "${score.asText()} ${title} \"\$\" {missing}",
                style = textStyle9,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun Float.asText() = if (this % 1f == 0f) toLong().toString() else toString()
}
